title: Kuda Tak Mahu Jalan
genre: Bajau dalling-dalling (Sabah west-coast gambus and tambourine dance song)
subject: A Bajau boy in Kota Belud grooming his pony Si Merah for the horsemen's parade, who finds the pony only trots when someone sings the dalling-dalling, so he must sing the whole parade route.
caption: Bajau dalling-dalling Sabah west-coast dance song, brisk bouncing two-step. Gambus playing a quick ornamented lead line, tambourine shaking steady sixteenth patterns, small gong marking each bar, gendang drum with a hopping pattern, violin doubling the melody. Live dance-floor feel, tambourine up front, dry room. Male vocal, bright mid register, call-and-response phrasing with a group answer, clearly sung. 124 BPM, G major. Upbeat, cheeky, cheerful. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No trap drums, no autotune, no synth bass, no rap, no EDM drop, no electric guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - gambus and tambourine, bright two-step]

[Verse 1]
Pagi-pagi kusikat Si Merah
Pelana baru, jambul pun rapi
Orang kampung sudah berkumpul
Si Merah berdiri, tak mahu jalan

[Pre-Chorus]
Kutarik tali, dia menguap
Kuberi gula, dia pandang langit

[Chorus]
Dalling-dalling, nyanyi dulu
Si Merah baru mahu melangkah
Dalling-dalling, nyanyi lagi
Kalau berhenti, dia pun berhenti

[Verse 2]
Sepanjang jalan sampai ke padang
Aku menyanyi sampai serak suara
Kanak-kanak ketawa di tepi pagar
Si Merah menari macam bintang

[Pre-Chorus]
Pak Imam tepuk tangan juga
Gadis di kedai senyum malu

[Chorus]
Dalling-dalling, nyanyi dulu
Si Merah trot, aku pula letih
Dalling-dalling, nyanyi lagi
Esok kita jalan senyap, boleh?

[Outro - tambourine and gambus, last bright flourish]
Dalling-dalling, Si Merah
Jalan lagi, jalan lagi
